verdict.rationale: GitHub documents Copilot as an assistant built into the product. Users can delegate coding tasks to the Copilot cloud agent from GitHub.com and mobile. The agent researches, plans, makes changes on a branch and opens pull requests, and can also be assigned reviews. Community items in the pack concern outages and pricing and are off-topic for this story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of delegation quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: GitHub Copilot is built into GitHub, so you can use it without installing anything.
Explore your repositories, plan changes, and delegate coding tasks to GitHub Copilot without leaving GitHub.com.
Copilot can research a repository, create an implementation plan, and make code changes on a branch. You can review the diff, iterate, and create a pull request when you're ready.
Manage projects and assign tasks to Copilot, all from your mobile device.
A change can start as an issue, be picked up by an agent, return as a pull request, get reviewed for quality and security, and be merged.
